subject: infra.connect
name: Third mobile network operator licence
what_would_settle_it: An Ethiopian Communications Authority licensing round, tender or ministerial decision on a third full operator licence.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the acquisition line closed: Telecommunications Licensing Directive 792/2021 is now held, so the framework exists and what is missing is an award; a 2023 request for qualifications was launched then paused mid-2023

subject: geopol.gulf
section: Artificial intelligence and the technology sector
name: Gulf digital cooperation
what_would_settle_it: An MoU, investment or ministerial readout naming a Gulf state counterparty in Ethiopian digital infrastructure, AI or payments.
disposition: absence stands, dated — a January 2026 joint ministerial statement, a December 2025 ambassadorial meeting and a June 2026 dialogue with a signed academy-to-academy memorandum establish a live UAE engagement track in which technology appears as a theme; none names Ethiopian digital infrastructure, artificial intelligence or payments

subject: finance.budget
name: Audit of digital spending for any in-scope year
what_would_settle_it: An Office of the Federal Auditor General report for EFY 2017 or later; its published library stops at EFY 2016.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the acquisition returned only OFAG’s own announcement of the EFY 2017 report; the report itself is not published and no digital spending is quantified in it

subject: gov.protect
name: Independent data-protection safeguards over the national digital identity
what_would_settle_it: a published data-protection impact assessment for the national digital identity, a statutory limit on state access to its data, or a redress mechanism a registrant could use

subject: gov.policy
name: National broadband strategy
what_would_settle_it: A named national broadband strategy or plan, adopted by the Council of Ministers or the communications regulator, with targets and a period.
disposition: absence stands, dated — the government-commissioned 2023 e-government assessment recommended a broadband plan be developed; Digital Ethiopia 2030 commits to nationwide broadband and a mapping system was rolled out, but neither is a broadband strategy and no such instrument was located
